The central technical concept for this page — grading the ground so water moves away from a structure rather than pooling. Defined precisely by ORSC/IRC R401.3 (see next row)

VERIFIED DIRECTLY 2026-09-08 against ICC's published Oregon Residential Specialty Code (2017/2021/2023 editions all carry the same language): grade shall fall a minimum of 6 inches within the first 10 feet from the foundation (~5% slope); where physical barriers prohibit this, a minimum 5% slope plus a drain or swale is required; impervious surfaces within 10 feet of the foundation shall slope not less than 2% away from the building. This is the real, Oregon-adopted code standard — not a generic '2% rule' folk figure. This is the single most load-bearing authority citation on this page
